title: GamesFile
description: A games file: the games a catalogue run checks.

schema_version.description: The file format version. Must equal the schema version this dyno reads.

GameEntry.description: One game in a games file. It needs a build, a launch URL or both.

build.description: The build folder or .zip, relative to the games file.

id.description: Unique in the file. Shards split the games in id order.

launch_url.description: An http or https URL, checked when the file loads.

release.description: The release version label for the result.
